title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. translated_title: Atomic MathReasoner：面向数学大语言模型的原子推理技能实例级组合
translated_abstract: 大多数现有方法将大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理当作一种整体性能力加以增强，然而不同的数学问题实际上需要不同的推理技能。近期的研究从更细粒度的视角出发，将数学推理分解为原子技能，并为各项能力开发专门的模块。但是，如何有效利用这些原子能力仍未得到充分探索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Atomic MathReasoner（AMR），一个用于组合原子推理技能的实例级框架。AMR 首先训练一个面向特定能力的 LoRA 专家库，并在留出的验证子集上进行无梯度优化，以发现一组多样化的低损失组合原型。它利用参考解答的词元级负对数似然来评估每个原型的偏好，并通过……对模糊的分配进行过滤（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了 Atomic MathReasoner（AMR），一种实例级框架：通过训练能力专用的 LoRA 专家库并用无梯度优化在验证子集上发现低损失组合原型，再依据参考解答的词元级负对数似然为每个数学问题分配最合适的原子推理技能组合，从而有效利用原子能力提升数学大语言模型的推理表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework that composes atomic reasoning skills by training capability-specific LoRA experts, discovering diverse low-loss composition prototypes via gradient-free optimization on held-out validation subsets, and assigning prototypes to each problem instance based on the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, enabling more effective use of atomic abilities for mathematical LLMs.
